messages:
Oliver-CS: FYI hitting a customer escalation — acme-internal is seeing repeated 503s and spikes in inference latency on their Dedicated pool since ~09:15 PT. Their SLOs at risk.

Oliver-CS: Reproduction snippet from them:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood/collections/gen -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
"503: model allocation failed"
```

Devin-ENG: assigning to me for initial triage. Can you drop the request IDs / sample request bodies and the pool id? Also which model variant they're pinned to?

Oliver-CS: Pool id: ded-az1-27, model: gptx-13b-q8_2025-05, sample request ids: rQ9f2, rQ9f7. They said it started after a rolling kernel update on their dedicated hosts.

Maria-OPS: I see noisy failures from that pool in the infra logs (OOM+kernel messages). Suggest temporary route to fallback pool ded-fallback-1 with same model family while we investigate. Will need engineering sign-off to enable automatic fallback.

Samir-SRE: I can coordinate the fallback. Quick checklist:
- confirm inference runtime will accept requests for ded-fallback-1 (devin)
- prepare canary traffic shift (maria)
- hotfix path if we find a regression in kernel runtime (devin/sre)

Jess-PROD: Need an owner for customer comms and SLA impact calc. Oliver, can you handle comms? We need an ETA we can tell them within 1 hour.

Devin-ENG: I'll validate runtime compatibility and run a small repro against ded-fallback-1. If OK, we can shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% across 30m. Tentative ETA: shift started in 25m if nothing blocks.

Oliver-CS: I'll message the customer and give 30m ETA for a mitigation plan. I'll note potential SLA credit if we cross the threshold. Thanks.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: route-shift/ded-fallback-1 -> scheduled by devin-eng, job id 8842.

Samir-SRE: Action items assigned:
- devin-eng: verify fallback runtime + run repro (ETA 20m)
- maria-ops: prepare canary and monitor dashboards (ETA 15m)
- oliver-cs: customer comms (ETA 10m)
- jess-prod: prepare SLA calc template and escalation doc (ETA 30m)

Devin-ENG: Found repro logs: runtime error allocating shared memory on a subset of hosts (stack trace attached). Proceeding with canary on ded-fallback-1 now.

Maria-OPS: Canary traffic shifted to ded-fallback-1 10% — monitoring.

Oliver-CS: Customer updated. They prefer the fallback for now. Marking this thread for follow-ups.

Jess-PROD: Recording for postmortem and to check if rolling kernel update needs rollback policy. :eyes:

Samir-SRE: I'll keep this thread open; will create incident ticket if errors continue past next hour.
